description:
Per-bar on-chain metric time series for a token. One request returns a bar-indexed series with any combination of SmartMoneyNetflow, SmartMoneyHoldings, ExchangeNetflow, WhaleNetInflow and HolderConcentration. Interval is 1h, 4h, 1d or 1w; top_n is how many top holders HolderConcentration sums; the only provider is nansen. Native ETH is read as WETH, and the token must be deployed on the chain asked for. Prefer this over firing many point queries when the user wants a historical or trailing-window view.

[Access: pay 0.05 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]

chain.description: Chain name or slug, e.g. ethereum or base.

date_from.description: ISO date string for the start of the window.

date_to.description: ISO date string for the end of the window.

metrics.description: Metric names to include in the series.

provider.description: Optional upstream override; omitted uses the existing server default.

symbol.description: Asset symbol, e.g. BTC or ETH.

top_n.description: Return only the first this many.

name: get_onchain_series
